pairs.why: The two flat wall clocks are almost identical; B's slightly cooler, deeper green stripes sit a little nearer the real card's background.
A is a flat wall-mounted clock casting a soft shadow on the striped wall like the real card, while B stands on a floor plane and reads as a desk object.
B hangs flat on the wall with a soft drop shadow like the real card, while A sits on a ground plane.
B matches the real card's wall-mounted, straight-on layout with a wall shadow, while A stands on a floor.
A's matte, painted brown wood sitting in the scene matches the soft illustrated finish of the real cards, while B is a glossy, saturated orange plastic slab.
B's compact ball with a glowing swirl on a curled stand reads more instantly and has a richness closer to the polished real renders, though both are glossy and A's palette is calmer.
A has a clean, compact toy silhouette with soft volumes like the submarine, while B adds fussy rivets, bands and oversized fins.
A's chunky, soft, matte teal disc matches the real cards' soft toy plastic, while B is a shiny chrome metallic saucer.
